objects.name: messages_channel_created_idx
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX messages_channel_created_idx ON messages(channel_id, created_at, message_id)

objects.name: recordings_channel_started_idx
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX recordings_channel_started_idx ON recordings(channel_id, started_at)

objects.name: messages
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE messages ( message_row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, message_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, guild_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_channel_id TEXT, channel_name TEXT, author_id TEXT NOT NULL, author_username TEXT NOT NULL, author_display_name TEXT, author_is_bot INTEGER NOT NULL, webhook_id TEXT, message_type INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, reply_to_message_id TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, edited_at INTEGER, observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL, attachments_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', embeds_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', author_avatar_url TEXT)

objects.name: messages_fts
objects.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE messages_fts USING fts5(content, content='messages', content_rowid='message_row_id', tokenize='unicode61')

objects.name: recordings
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE recordings ( recording_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, guild_id TEXT NOT NULL, guild_name TEXT, channel_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel_name TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, ended_at INTEGER, duration_ms INTEGER, recovered_after_restart INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error TEXT, directory_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

objects.name: transcript_segments
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE transcript_segments ( segment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, recording_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transcripts(recording_id), segment_index INTEGER NOT NULL, start_offset_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, end_offset_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, source_interval_id TEXT, speaker_user_id TEXT, speaker_username TEXT, speaker_display_name TEXT, UNIQUE(recording_id, segment_index))

objects.name: transcript_segments_fts
objects.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE transcript_segments_fts USING fts5(text, content='transcript_segments', content_rowid='segment_id', tokenize='unicode61')

objects.name: transcripts
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE transcripts ( recording_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings(recording_id), status TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, queued_at INTEGER NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER, finished_at INTEGER, error TEXT, language TEXT)

objects.name: messages_fts_delete
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER messages_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON messages BEGIN INSERT INTO messages_fts(messages_fts, rowid, content) VALUES('delete', old.message_row_id, old.content); END

objects.name: messages_fts_insert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER messages_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN INSERT INTO messages_fts(rowid, content) VALUES(new.message_row_id, new.content); END

objects.name: messages_fts_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER messages_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF content ON messages BEGIN INSERT INTO messages_fts(messages_fts, rowid, content) VALUES('delete', old.message_row_id, old.content); INSERT INTO messages_fts(rowid, content) VALUES(new.message_row_id, new.content); END

objects.name: transcript_segments_fts_delete
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER transcript_segments_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON transcript_segments BEGIN INSERT INTO transcript_segments_fts(transcript_segments_fts, rowid, text) VALUES('delete', old.segment_id, old.text); END

objects.name: transcript_segments_fts_insert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER transcript_segments_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON transcript_segments BEGIN INSERT INTO transcript_segments_fts(rowid, text) VALUES(new.segment_id, new.text); END

objects.name: transcript_segments_fts_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER transcript_segments_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF text ON transcript_segments BEGIN INSERT INTO transcript_segments_fts(transcript_segments_fts, rowid, text) VALUES('delete', old.segment_id, old.text); INSERT INTO transcript_segments_fts(rowid, text) VALUES(new.segment_id, new.text); END
